title: Check yourself: A headless run, its JSON and the job status

questions.stem: A CI step runs Claude Code unattended, and each issue it reports must be posted as an inline note. Which flags make the reply usable for that?

options.text: `--output-format text` with a prompt asking for a bulleted list
options.says: Ruled out because text leaves the entries to be parsed from prose, and "a decision made on prose is a guess".

options.text: `--max-turns` with a high limit so that the list is complete
options.says: Ruled out because a limit bounds the loop and does not shape the answer: "The run exits with an error at the limit".
The schema makes the answer a validated object in `structured_output`.

options.text: `--bare` alone, which formats replies for scripts
options.says: Ruled out because the flag controls what the run loads, with "no hooks, skills, MCP servers, memory or CLAUDE.md", and formats nothing.

questions.stem: A review run ends with the subtype `success`, yet the object holds no `structured_output`. What should the job do?

options.text: Fail, because no valid answer exists
options.says: A run without a valid answer is a failure whatever its subtype says.

options.text: Pass, since the run reports success
options.says: Ruled out because the documentation says "Treat that case as a failure as well".

options.text: Retry the same request until a value appears
options.says: Ruled out because "Retrying inside the job repeats cost with no reason to expect a different result".

options.text: Pass, with a note that nothing was reported
options.says: Ruled out because "A job never passes by saying nothing", and a silent pass cannot be told from a failed run.
